Heterogeneous graph transformer convolution

Source: R/hgt.R
hgt_conv.Rd

One layer of the heterogeneous graph transformer (HGT, Hu et al. 2020). For a target node \(t\) of type \(\tau(t)\), an incoming edge from \(s\) through relation \(r\), and head \(h\) with \(D\) channels, $$k_s = K_{\tau(s)} x_s,\ q_t = Q_{\tau(t)} x_t,\ v_s = V_{\tau(s)} x_s,$$ $$e_{st}^h = (k_s^h W^{att}_{r,h}) \cdot q_t^h \ \mu_{r,h} / \sqrt{D},$$ $$\alpha_{st}^h = \mathrm{softmax}_{s \in N(t)}(e_{st}^h),$$ where the softmax runs over all incoming edges of \(t\), across relations. The update is $$\tilde h_t = \sum_s \alpha_{st} (v_s W^{msg}_{r}),\quad h_t' = \beta_{\tau(t)} A_{\tau(t)}(\mathrm{GELU}(\tilde h_t)) + (1 - \beta_{\tau(t)}) x_t,$$ with \(\beta = \mathrm{sigmoid}(\text{skip})\) a learned gate per type (the skip term is used only when input and output sizes match). Node types without incoming edges get \(A_{\tau}(0)\) plus the skip term.

Usage

hgt_conv(
  node_types,
  relations,
  in_features,
  out_features,
  heads = 2L,
  temporal_encoding = FALSE
)

Arguments

node_types

Character vector of node types.

relations

Character vector of relation keys "src__rel__dst".

in_features

Input size, the same for every node type.

out_features

Output size; must be divisible by heads.

heads

Number of attention heads.

temporal_encoding

Use the relative temporal encoding.

Value

An nn_module called as layer(x_dict, edge_index_dict, edge_time_dict = NULL) that returns a named list of node feature tensors.

Details

With temporal_encoding = TRUE, the relative temporal encoding of the paper is added to each source representation before the key and value projections: for an edge with relative time \(\Delta t\) (the relation's edge_time, see hetero_graph_data()), \(\hat x_s = x_s + \mathrm{Linear}(\mathrm{Base}(\Delta t))\) with \(\mathrm{Base}(\Delta t)_{2i} = \sin(\Delta t / 10000^{2i/F})\) and \(\mathrm{Base}(\Delta t)_{2i+1} = \cos(\Delta t / 10000^{2i/F})\). Relations without edge_time use \(\Delta t = 0\).

Cost is \(O(E H D^2)\) for the relation transforms plus \(O(N F F')\) for the type projections; the layer keeps an E by heads attention tensor per target type in last_attention.

References

Hu, Dong, Wang and Sun (2020) Heterogeneous graph transformer. Proceedings of The Web Conference.

Examples

if (torch::torch_is_installed()) {
  hg <- add_reverse_relations(dataset_synthetic_hetero(seed = 1))
  ht <- hetero_tensors(hg)
  layer <- hgt_conv(hg$node_types, names(hg$edges), 8, 8, heads = 2)
  x <- list(drug = torch::torch_randn(60, 8), protein = torch::torch_randn(80, 8))
  lapply(layer(x, ht$edge_index), dim)
}
#> $drug
#> [1] 60  8
#> 
#> $protein
#> [1] 80  8
#>
